tasks.short: Discipline staff for department rule violations

steps.what: Assess established violation findings and select a proportionate disciplinary response within authority
Explain disciplinary action to staff and complete the required decision record

tasks.design: Keep disciplinary judgement and explanation human, using current procedures in {DOCS} and the existing decision record in {HCM}. No sanction recommendation engine or automated staff action is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: A proportionate response requires context, fairness and authority.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support accountable decisions without establishing a new saving.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing comparable cases and preserving the staff member's procedural rights.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining the reasons and hearing concerns fairly.
tasks.altitude: No change to disciplinary authority or time.

reach.task: Check a disciplinary procedure and appeal route

evidence.claim: Retaining disciplinary judgement and communication is an E1 design judgement.

assumptions: Boundary starts with established findings and covers disciplinary decision and communication; the separate misconduct investigation is not counted again.
Supervisor reads the findings and records the decision during fully retained steps. No structured severity score or automated sanction input is assumed.
No new workflow means zero incremental upkeep; existing record runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Disciplinary authority and mandatory local consultation
research_questions: Which actions require referral beyond the supervisor's authority?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100; no changed step, gross0 and net0.

tasks.short: Evaluate staff performance and authorise promotions and transfers

steps.what: Observe subordinate performance and provide ongoing feedback
Compile existing observations and authorised records for the performance review
Evaluate performance in context and discuss development and career options
Authorise eligible promotions or transfers and record the exact personnel decision

tasks.design: Configure source-linked review packs in {TALENT} using existing observations and authorised documents. The supervisor retains observation, contextual assessment and every promotion or transfer decision recorded in {HCM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review preparation repeats retrieval and copying of existing observations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native review templates can organise sources without scoring or ranking staff.
tasks.still_hard: Fair assessment across different duties, opportunities and circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding context and discussing development honestly.
tasks.altitude: Less review-pack assembly; personnel decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native source-linked performance packs are an E1 design assumption; the digest does not establish performance-assessment savings.
Dutch staff-monitoring arrangements involve works council consent; this design needs local scope review.

assumptions: Boundary covers supervisor observation, review preparation, assessment and decisions, excluding personnel administration after authorisation.

Supervisor produces observations in s1 and captures employee identifier, review period, observation date and source link in s2. Its nine retained hours include first capture, missing-record handling and completeness review.
Test native review templates first; no new continuous monitoring, comparative score or inferred performance label is introduced.
Two incremental hours per 100 baseline hours cover permissions and review-template maintenance.
unknowns: Existing records, review preparation effort and personnel authority
research_questions: Do source-linked packs reduce preparation after capture and fairness checks?

tasks.short: Review written orders for adherence to legal requirements

steps.what: Identify the exact written order and retrieve current applicable legal sources
Map order clauses to cited legal requirements and identify possible conflicts or omissions

loop.input: Exact order version and checked legal source set
loop.output: Quoted order clauses, cited legal passages and possible issues with uncertainty
loop.check: Supervisor reads each cited passage and verifies applicability, exceptions, omitted obligations and the meaning of each suggested conflict
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported sources or unresolved interpretation return to manual review
loop.why_not_simpler: Native retrieval comes first, but semantic differences between prose clauses and legal requirements need contextual reading

steps.what: Assess legal applicability, exceptions and unresolved issues against the full order and sources
Record the review conclusion and refer required changes or disputed interpretations

tasks.design: Test native legal-source retrieval in {DOCS}, then use a bounded {WORKFLOW} reading step only for a cited clause issue map. The supervisor checks meaning, applicability and omissions before recording a conclusion; disputed interpretation goes to a legal adviser.
tasks.previous_blocker: Review requires locating current law and comparing prose with order clauses.
tasks.enabler_now: Source retrieval and constrained drafting can prepare a comparison without deciding legality.
tasks.still_hard: Exceptions, conflicting authorities and legal applicability to operational facts.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable interpretation and recognising when specialist advice is necessary.
tasks.altitude: Less source retrieval and initial mapping; legal review responsibility is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Source-constrained comparison with full human legal review is an E1 design assumption; no digest case demonstrates this task's saving.

assumptions: Boundary is review of a supplied order, excluding its original drafting and later operational execution.

Order issuer produces the existing written order. Supervisor captures version, jurisdiction, effective date and source identifiers in s1's ten retained hours; missing or uncertain sources trigger manual retrieval there.

S2 uses prose from the checked source set, not a free structured legal-compliance flag. Its eighteen retained hours include semantic draft checks; s3 adds full applicability and omission review without double deducting either.
Try native search before the bounded loop; four incremental supervisor hours per 100 baseline hours cover source freshness, access and sampled draft checks.
unknowns: Order complexity, source access and local legal-review responsibilities
research_questions: Does comparison preparation save time after full legal checks and manual fallbacks?

already_counted.description: Draft meaning checks and manual mapping exceptions

incremental.description: Legal-source freshness and bounded-draft quality checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R78; gross22 less4 upkeep gives18 net. Novel legal issues may eliminate preparation gains and yield minus4; final interpretation and disposition remain50.

Testify in court and answer questions within personal knowledge

tasks.enabler_now: Document access can support the witness without replacing the interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Answering disputed questions accurately within disclosure limits.
tasks.human_edge: Truthful testimony and clear coordination with officials.
tasks.altitude: No change to testimony time or disclosure authority.

evidence.claim: Direct interagency cooperation and court testimony remain human in this E1 judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is direct cooperation and testimony, excluding separate evidence compilation and travel.

No new technology means zero incremental upkeep.
